title: Trump Hosts 9/11 First Responders at White House With 21-Foot Ground Zero Steel Beam
detail: President Trump hosted a 'Steel Across America' tribute event on the White House Ellipse on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, ahead of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. The Tunnel to Towers Foundation's traveling memorial — a 21-foot, 16,900-pound steel beam recovered from the World Trade Center's South Tower that has crossed 21 states — was displayed for first responders and administration officials. Trump and Tunnel to Towers CEO Frank Siller both spoke; the foundation, started by Siller after his firefighter brother Stephen died in the attacks, said it plans to deliver 343 mortgage-free homes this year, one for each FDNY firefighter lost on 9/11. Vice President Vance traveled to Ground Zero in New York City for a parallel commemoration, while other administration officials represented the White House at the Flight 93 memorial in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. White House spokesperson Olivia Wales said the president aimed to 'renew our sacred vow that we will never forget.'

media.caption: President Trump at the 'Steel Across America' 9/11 tribute event on the White House Ellipse

title: Treasury Sanctions 27 Iranian Airlines Under 'Operation Economic Outcast'
detail: The Treasury Department on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, sanctioned 36 targets — including 27 of Iran's remaining commercial airlines, aircraft-procurement front companies, and cargo service providers — under Executive Order 13902 as part of Secretary Scott Bessent's 'Operation Economic Outcast' campaign. The action targeted Mahan Air (first designated in 2011) and newer carriers including Varesh Airlines, Sepehran Airlines, and Qeshm Air, several of which still fly to Dubai, Muscat, and Kuwait City. Bessent said: 'Under Operation Economic Outcast, we promised severe consequences for those providing financial lifelines to the Iranian regime. Today, we followed through on that promise... Let this be a warning to anyone doing business with Iran's remaining airlines, all of which we sanctioned today: You are at risk of being cut off from the global financial system.' The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network separately alerted US banks to increase scrutiny of transactions linked to Iranian aviation procurement.

media.caption: Treasury sanctioned 27 Iranian airlines and 9 other entities under Operation Economic Outcast
